newsitem.title: USA: NHL-MIGHTY DUCKS SIGN FREE AGENT SANDSTROM.
newsitem.headline: NHL-MIGHTY DUCKS SIGN FREE AGENT SANDSTROM.

text.p: The Mighty Ducks of Anaheim on Friday signed free agent right wing Tomas Sandstrom, who helped the Detroit Red Wings win a Stanley Cup last season.

Sandstrom, 32, acquired from Pittsburgh in late January, had nine goals and nine assists in 34 games for Detroit. The Swede had a combined 18 goals and 24 assists for 42 points in 74 games last season.
"Tomas Sandstrom brings us veteran experience and scoring ability to our forward lines," said Ducks general manager Jack Ferreira. "We are excited to have him join the Mighty Ducks."

A member of eight Swedish National Teams, Sandstrom has played 13 NHL seasons for the New York Rangers, Los Angeles, Pittsburgh and Detroit, and has 370 goals, 437 assists and 807 points in 848 games.
In 135 playoff games, Sandstrom has 32 goals and 49 assists.
